speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Give me the scale, then. You asked me to weigh it. I will not have it asked and then left in the air.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: The scale is under the board. It is honest. I keep it so the bailiff need not teach me the trade.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: He has wanted a witness since Thursday. I told him the wheat was witness enough, and he would not spend the word.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: It meets.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Say the rest, so I have heard it in a house and not only in my head.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: It meets the assize. That is the rest. The loaf is small. The scale is not short.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She will not say it prettier than that. Sit down, Sadler. Four of us are left, and the four of us can eat.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: I have not won the shop. I have not lost it. I will take the difference, and I will sit.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: Then take the cheese with the difference. The children have the lane. We have a minute, if nobody spends it on a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can spend a minute eating. I heard the nothing she said over the hands. I am not going to explain it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Good. Eat. I have said the scale, and I have said nothing about the hands, and both of those are finished.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: Your cuff has Saturday on it, Will. I was not going to say so while the children were inventing a corner.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: His mother has already said the cuff. A second time and it becomes a parish matter. Leave it.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Flour covers a multitude of cuffs. I recommend the trade, and I know you will not take it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have a trade. It does not keep the ink off. Toward the middle of the afternoon I am taking the three of them to the water. I have told them the end of it.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: A book will not drown in a hand of water. A quarrel might. Bring them back fit for Joan.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Joan has them after. He and I are for the field path while the light is still light. That is the next thing, and it is not this table.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: Then finish the cheese. It is the last of what kept. I am not making a second last because a man has come home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tuesday is settled. I am eating, and I am not settling it again.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Seven of the clock. Twelve men. You are one. I will not say the ale a second time. My cousin has it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Once is the right number of times for a promise in a kitchen. We have had our once.
